description: ViewModel for managing the user's cryptocurrency watchlist, incorporating loading states and user interactions.

classes.name: WatchlistViewModel
classes.description: ViewModel that handles the loading and modifying of a user's watchlist.

classes.name: WatchlistUiState
classes.description: Sealed class representing different states of the watchlist UI.

methods.name: loadWatchlist
methods.description: Loads the user's watchlist and updates the UI state accordingly.

methods.name: addToWatchlist
methods.description: Adds a specified coin to the user's watchlist and updates the UI state.

methods.name: removeFromWatchlist
methods.description: Removes a specified coin from the user's watchlist and updates the UI state.
